observations: Photo 0 shows a tabletop sewing machine with 'IDEAL TOPSTAR Super Automatic' branding visible on the body.
A foot pedal (rheostat-style electric control pedal) and a coiled power cord with a plug are shown next to the machine.
Visible dust, surface grime, and some discoloration/rust spots on the metal housing and dial area.
Tension dials, stitch-length dial, and bobbin winder are visible; needle area shows some lint/thread residue.
No power outlet, stitching sample, or machine running shown; it sits on floor tiles next to an unrelated cushion.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows an electric foot pedal (rheostat controller) and power cord with plug, indicating an electric-motor-driven machine rather than a purely manual hand-crank type.
No photo or clip shows the machine running, stitching, or powering on.

risks.risk: Motor/electrical function unknown — could be dead, burnt, or missing internal wiring despite visible cord and pedal.
risks.proof: A short video of the machine plugged in, pedal pressed, needle moving and motor humming.

risks.risk: Mechanical condition (bobbin case, tension assembly, belt) could be worn, rusted, or seized given visible dust and grime.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the bobbin area, belt, and underside of the machine.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (extra needles, bobbins, manual, extension table) common with vintage machines.
risks.proof: Photo of accessory box or listed accessories included.
risks.if_unproven: priced as base unit only, no accessories

risks.risk: Cosmetic rust or corrosion on metal parts could worsen over time, affecting resale and functionality.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the full metal frame and base for rust extent.

proof_requests: Video of the machine plugged in and running (needle moving, motor sound) to confirm electrical function.
Close-up photos of the bobbin case, belt, and underside mechanism.
Photo of any accessories (extra needles, bobbins, manual, cover) included in the sale.
Clear full-body photo to assess rust/corrosion extent.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as an Ideal Topstar Super Automatic sewing machine from the visible branding, but no proof of working condition is shown and the seller's 'manual' claim is contradicted by the visible electric pedal and cord, so it must be priced at worst case as a non-functioning electric machine needing inspection.
